d: Naukri ke dauran aapki sailri ka ek hissa har mahine provident phand yani eepief men jama hota hai. is par byaj bhi milta hai aur ritayarment tak ek bari rakam taiyar ho jati hai. kya ritayarment ke bad puri rakam nikal lena behtar hai ya ise is khate men rakhkar har mahine kuchh paisa nikalna chahie? isi ko dhyan men rakhte hue karmachari bhavishy nidhi sangthan yani eepiefao ne ek naee suvidha ko manjuri di hai. iska nam hai sistamaitik vidrol plan yani esdablyupi. ye plan kya hai, isse kis tarah har mahine paise milenge aur isse kise fayda ho sakta hai? samjhie is vidiyo ke zarie.
